name: application-progress-steps-toast
title: Progress Steps Toast
description: Long-running-task toast showing overall progress plus a per-step checklist with done, active (spinning), and pending states.
useWhen: A background operation (deploy, import, export, migration) has multiple distinct sub-steps worth surfacing.
Users benefit from seeing which specific step is currently running, not just a single percentage.
The task takes long enough that a persistent toast is more appropriate than a blocking spinner.
avoidWhen: The task is a single atomic operation with no meaningful sub-steps — use toast-stack's simple toast instead.
The task completes in under a second or two — a step-by-step toast adds more visual noise than value for near-instant operations.
You need many toasts stacked at once — pair this with toast-stack's positioning/queue logic rather than reinventing it here.
responsiveBehavior: The toast is a fixed max-w-sm card intended for a corner-anchored position; it fills its container's available width up to that cap.
accessibility: The whole toast uses role="status" so screen readers announce step transitions without needing focus.
Each step's state is shown through a distinct icon (check, spinner, dot) plus text styling (line-through, bold, muted), not color alone.
The 'N of M' label gives a concrete, announced sense of progress alongside the visual bar.

variants.title: Progress steps toast
variants.description: Four-step deploy task with one completed (struck through), one active (spinning), and two pending steps, plus an overall progress bar.
accessibility: role="status" ensures step completion is announced as the task progresses.

variants.title: Progress steps toast (Dark)
variants.description: Progress steps toast adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Progress bar, icon, and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
